title: My Stepson Took $128K And Left Me A $4,100 Check. So I Voided His Sale And Now He Grinds Nibs
description: After 27 years as a court reporter, I loaned my stepson $128,000 from my pension to open a fountain pen boutique. He transferred the business to his girlfriend after a $580,000 offer and mailed me a $4,100 nib check, but I found the original promissory note and the hidden email proving fraud. Now he grinds nibs in my shop, where every receipt prints his fraud docket number. #InkOfDeceit #FamilyBetrayal #RevengeStory
thumb_text: HE TOOK MY $128K, NOW HE GRINDS NIBS
pinned_comment: Would you have voided the sale and made him grind nibs, or would you have handled your stepson taking $128,000 from your pension and sending a $4,100 nib check differently? Share your story in the comments.
